evidence.title: Introducing Scout: API Testing Built for AI Agents
evidence.excerpt: We built Scout, an open source CLI that gives coding agents a safe harness for testing APIs. Point it at an OpenAPI spec and it sweeps, fuzzes, and records findings - with guardrails on by default. In this walkthrough it finds three real bugs in the Swagger Petstore.
